en: Welcome to Easy Multi Profiler Web, version nine point one point two. This illustrated guide covers the metadata-only workflow.
zh: 欢迎使用 EasyMultiProfiler-Web 9.1.2。本图解教程介绍元数据工作流。

en: You can review public data and prepare analysis plans. Raw read downloads and R analysis are not connected in this mode.
zh: 可以查看公开数据并准备分析计划。此模式尚未接入原始 reads 下载和 R 分析。

en: From the repository folder, run the dependency check, then start the metadata launcher. Keep that terminal open.
zh: 在仓库目录运行依赖检查，再启动元数据服务。使用页面时请保持终端开启。

en: Open the local address shown here. Python version three point ten or later is required. R is not needed for metadata.
zh: 打开此处显示的本地地址。需要 Python 3.10 或更高版本；元数据功能不需要 R。

en: Use a public keyword to search G E O, or enter an accession and read its sample manifest. Review the study before selecting runs.
zh: 输入公开关键词检索 GEO，或输入 accession 读取样本清单。选择 runs 前先核对研究。

en: This saved public example lists one paired-end run and two FASTQ links. These are metadata records, not downloaded reads.
zh: 此已保存的公开示例列出一个双端 run 和两个 FASTQ 链接。它们只是元数据，不是已下载的 reads。

en: No runs are selected by default. Check the organism, library strategy, paired-end layout, and biological groups, then inspect the selected download plan.
zh: 默认不选择 run。核对物种、文库策略、单双端和实验分组，再检查所选下载计划。

en: Save the plan as JSON. Reported archive size excludes additional analysis space, and archive checksums have not been verified against local files.
zh: 将计划保存为 JSON。档案报告大小不含额外分析空间，档案校验值也尚未与本地文件核对。

en: For processed data, enter a G E O series in the matrix section and discover its supplementary files. Inspect each candidate before confirming a download.
zh: 在已处理矩阵区输入 GEO 系列编号并发现补充文件。确认下载前，先审阅每个候选文件。

en: Only supported text tables with a known size of at most thirty-two mebibytes can be downloaded. Archive bundles are not automatically unpacked.
zh: 仅支持已知大小不超过 32 MiB 的指定文本表格；不会自动解包归档文件。

scene: Prove the input, match the samples
en: A saved inspection of the example matrix found twenty-seven thousand, one hundred seventy-nine features and twelve samples. The Length column was excluded.
zh: 已保存的示例矩阵检查发现 27,179 个特征和 12 个样本；Length 列已排除。

scene: Prove the input, match the samples
en: Integer values alone do not prove raw counts. Check the authors' methods, and match sample annotations by exact identifiers rather than column order.
zh: 整数本身不能证明是原始计数。请核对作者方法，并按精确标识符匹配样本注释，而非按列顺序。

en: Choose a bulk R N A sequencing template. Review the steps, dataset provenance, sample labels, contrast, and any batch terms, then validate the design.
zh: 选择 bulk RNA-seq 模板。核对步骤、数据来源、样本标签、比较组和批次，再校验统计设计。

en: This synthetic teaching plan passes validation, but executable is still false. Passing preflight does not mean an analysis has run.
zh: 此人工教学计划通过了校验，但 executable 仍为 false。预检通过不代表已经运行分析。

scene: Keep papers and AI boundaries clear
en: The paper section can extract accession candidates from a local P D F. PubMed search is separate, and a candidate still needs scientific verification.
zh: 论文区可从本地 PDF 提取候选 accession。PubMed 检索是独立操作，候选仍需科学核实。

scene: Keep papers and AI boundaries clear
en: The agent is unconfigured here. If you configure a provider later, preview the selected context and consent before sending. The tools remain read-only.
zh: 此处尚未配置智能体。以后配置 Provider 时，应先预览所选上下文并确认发送；工具仍是只读的。

en: Keep your data sources, sample mapping, and plan together. Discovery, input verification, and execution are different steps. This mode supports review and planning.
zh: 请保留数据来源、样本映射和流程计划。发现、输入验证与执行是不同步骤；此模式支持审阅和规划。
